name: Local shell execution
description: Executes a local shell command after client-side permission classification and enforcement.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 在客户端完成权限分类和执行约束后执行本地 Shell 指令。
localizedDescription.en-US: Executes a local shell command after client-side permission classification and enforcement.

cwd.description: Working directory. Omit or use null for the current session directory, or the workspace root if unset.

timeoutMs.description: Execution timeout in milliseconds. Omit or use null for the default.

description.description: Human-readable reason shown in the shell task timeline.

runInBackground.description: Whether to return immediately with a background task id.
